evidence_classes.authority_validation: Two exact-JDTDB comet states from the sealed 2026.10.10.1 release are compared with freshly frozen official JPL Horizons geometric osculating ELEMENTS under the established live-product gates.
evidence_classes.physical_and_geometric_invariants: Every catalog member must produce finite elements and a finite normalized geometric-node projection inside admitted coverage.
evidence_classes.release_integrity: Every catalog leg is bound to the declared manifest and shard SHA-256 identities.

gate_origin: Pre-existing product tolerances from tests/integration/test_horizons_orbits.py::test_orbital_elements_match_horizons; no tolerance was widened from the measured catalog residuals.
limitations: The two authority cases are a representative release holdout, not 497 independent Horizons queries.

The release was built from Encke solution JPL#K273/22, which Horizons no longer serves; Encke is compared with the current JPL#K273/24 solution, so its residual includes the difference between the two solutions.
Halley's record is unchanged from 2026-09-28 in values and solution (JPL#75); it was re-retrieved so that both comets bind one fixture.
The asteroid holdouts are admitted by the separate 2026-10-29 asteroid receipt, not by this one.
